agent: an OpenHOI3 session building the parts of the original's Lua API that BlackICE's scripts call and the base game's do not
question: What each Lua method BlackICE's AI scripts reach and OpenHOI3 lacked answers: the country's variables and CSetVariableCommand, its unit list and the list's counts, its shares (CDistributionSetting) and CFixedPoint64, its free spies, subject flag and cabinet, CModifier::GetValue, the minister type database, CProvinceBuilding::GetCurrent, CSubUnitDefinition::IsTransport, CDiplomacyStatus::HasAnyAgreement, and CAIAgent::GetCountry.

addresses.name: CFixedPoint64::Get
addresses.comment: Lua `CFixedPoint64:Get()` (luabind: `float Get(fpml::fixed_point<__int64,48,15> const&)`). `fild qword [ecx]; fmul qword [0x160A2E0]` - the double 2^-15 (3.0517578125e-05) - then stored to a float on the stack and reloaded, so **the 48.15 value times 2^-15, rounded to single precision**. Bare `ret` at 0x46B465. What a share of IC or leadership reads as in a script. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-luaapi.md, section 11.
addresses.evidence: Read end to end, 0x46B450..0x46B465, int3 after; the constant at 0x160A2E0 read as a double gives 3.0517578125e-05. luabind.json pairs the Lua name Get on CFixedPoint64 with pointer 0x46B450. Wrong if the stored float were a double (the store is `fstp dword`).

addresses.name: CFixedPoint64::GetTruncated
addresses.comment: Lua `CFixedPoint64:GetTruncated()` **and `GetRounded()` - one body registered under both names**: `mov eax,[ecx]; mov ecx,[ecx+4]; shrd eax,ecx,0xF; sar ecx,0xF; ret`, the value shifted down 15 places arithmetically - **toward minus infinity**, so -1/32768 gives -1 - and its low 32 bits answered. So `GetRounded` does not round. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-luaapi.md, section 11.
addresses.evidence: Five instructions read, 0x46B470..0x46B47C. luabind.json gives pointer 0x46B470 for both GetTruncated and GetRounded on CFixedPoint64. Wrong if either registration resolved elsewhere.

addresses.name: VirtualThunkSlot3
addresses.no_signature: A pointer-to-virtual-member thunk: `mov eax,[ecx]; jmp dword ptr [eax+0xC]` tail-jumps into slot 3 of whatever `this` is, the caller's stack and return untouched, so its signature is the slot's.
addresses.comment: `mov eax,[ecx]; jmp dword ptr [eax+0xC]` - the pointer-to-virtual-member thunk for **slot 3**, beside VirtualThunkSlot13/14/17/18. Three references (0x40E21B, 0x466125, 0x8EC708), so class-free per trap 4. At 0x8EC707 it is pushed beside the string 'GetNeeded' (0x15EF130) in CDistributionSetting's luabind chain, with CDistributionSetting::GetBasePercentage (0x4C8920) beside 'GetPercentage' - so **Lua `CDistributionSetting:GetNeeded()` is slot 3**, each distributor's own GetNeeded (CDistributeProduction::GetNeeded 0x11A2E0 and its siblings; lend-lease, officers and espionage hold the folded WriteZeroInt64Out). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-luaapi.md, section 11.
addresses.evidence: Two instructions read; findRefs --address gives three references, the luabind one pushing it next to 'GetNeeded'. vtable.py --holding: in no table. Wrong if the string beside it at 0x8EC70C were another name.

addresses.name: WriteZeroInt64Out
addresses.comment: `*out = 0` (both dwords) and `ret 4`, with `this` in ECX ignored - **slot 3 of 17 tables**, folded: C3dObject and its kin, CCounterObject, CUnitArrow, and the three distributors with no need, CDistributeLendLease, CDistributeNCO and CDistributeEspionage. So `GetNeeded()` on the lend-lease, officer and espionage shares is nought. Class-free per trap 4. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-luaapi.md, section 11.
addresses.evidence: Read 0xABF870..0xABF884; vtable.py --holding 0xABF870 lists 17 tables, all slot 3. Written __stdcall because nothing reads ECX; as a slot it is reached as a __thiscall with the out pointer its one stack argument. Wrong if any holder's slot 3 were not this body.

addresses.name: CModifier::GetValue
addresses.signature: CFixedPoint* __thiscall CModifier::GetValue(CModifier* this, CFixedPoint* out, int type)
addresses.comment: Lua `modifier:GetValue(type)`: `*out = [this+0x18][type * 8]` (trap 5: an 8-byte entry per kind), `ret 8`, **no range check**. The number is the kind's place in the original's list of modifier kinds - the `ModifierType` enum registered on CModifier, `_MODIFIER_MINIMUM_REVOLT_RISK_` 0 to `_MODIFIER_OFFICER_RECRUITMENT_` 82, **57 (threat_resistance) left out of the registration** and 79 spelled `_MODIFIER_PARTISAN_EFFICENCY_`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-luaapi.md, section 11.
addresses.evidence: Read 0x4179E0..0x4179F2; luabind.json pointer and the CModifier enum (82 names, 0..82 without 57). Wrong if a kind's place in the startup list differed from its enum value - checked against the 83 kinds in order, each name matching but 57 and the misspelt 79.

addresses.name: CVariables::GetValue
addresses.revises: The comment said the create-on-read reaches the game only through CVariableTrigger::Evaluate because there are no direct callers; luabind.json registers this body as Lua `CVariables:GetVariable`, so every script read of a variable makes it too - a reach the comment denied
addresses.signature: int* __thiscall CVariables::GetValue(CVariables* this, int* out, Hoi3CString* name)
addresses.comment:
**The generic read of a script variable, and it creates the variable it fails to find.** 0x476F60 to two `ret 8` at 0x476F81 and 0x476F9F, 21 instructions read end to end, eleven int3 before and fourteen after.

    v = this->slot1(name)                 ; GuiTypeTree_FindByString
    if (v) { *out = v->value (+0x1C); return out }
    CVariables::AddVariable(this@EDI, name, 0)
    *out = 0; return out

**It is Lua's `CVariables:GetVariable(name)`** (luabind.json), so it has no direct callers in the image and is reached by every script that reads a country's variable - BlackICE's AI reads them by the hundred. Corrected 2026-11-16: this said the create-on-read reached the game only through `CVariableTrigger::Evaluate`, which does the same thing inline. A variable made so is at 0 and CVariables::SaveContents leaves a 0 out, so nothing in the game or the save tells it from one never made. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-luaapi.md, section 11.
addresses.evidence: luabind.json: GetVariable on CVariables at pointer 0x476F60. Wrong if that pointer were another body.
